displayName: 尤利乌斯·蒙雷 Julius Monrey
description: Unofficial Julius Monrey fan-art companion from Alice in the Country of Hearts. Original clockmaker animation includes carefully aligning a tiny gear, listening to a pocket watch, adjusting working spectacles, patient waiting and an articulated hop. Coat trim is a simplified creative adaptation of the selected daily form. Independently drawn fan art; no official affiliation or authorization is claimed.
